meta.name: install-and-verify
meta.description: Verify that a web app change actually works by driving the running app from the inside (DOM, network, routing, console, framework state) instead of screenshots or guessing. Use after any user-facing change, when a fix is claimed but unproven, when a test passes but the UI is broken, or when you need a real verdict rather than "looks right". Also use to install and wire up Reticle in a project that does not have it yet.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动运行中的网页应用,实测改动是否真的生效
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果改完前端心里没底,想要真实结果而不是靠截图猜测
copy.tagline_en: Drive the running web app to verify a change actually works
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you changed the UI and want proof it works, not guesswork

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 用 reticle_* 工具从内部驱动你已打开的网页应用,读 DOM、网络、路由、控制台和框架状态,不靠截图;项目没装 Reticle 时它先装好接线,再给出改动是否成立的 verdict。
howto.when: 在用户界面改动之后、修复被声称完成但未经验证、测试通过但界面坏掉等情况下触发;项目尚未安装 Reticle 时也由它接管安装。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude drives your open web app via reticle_* tools (DOM, network, console, state) instead of screenshots, wires Reticle into a project that lacks it, and returns a verified or unknown verdict on the change.
howto.when_en: Use after any user-facing change, when a fix is claimed but unproven, when a test passes but the UI is broken, or to install and wire up Reticle in a project that does not have it yet.

say_en.text: Verify that this change actually works.
say_en.note: Drives the app and returns a verdict.

say_en.text: This project has no Reticle — install it and prove one flow.
say_en.note: Runs init, then records a flow.

say_en.text: Replay the saved "login" flow and tell me if it still works.
